Subject: Recap + proposed next steps for Altai Health POC

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goal: accelerate clinician note summarization and triage to reduce charting time by ~30%.
- Success metrics: 15% reduction in time-per-note for 3 pilot clinicians, F1 > 0.82 on entity extraction evals, and no PHI leakage in logs.
- Tech constraints: Altai runs on Azure with strict egress rules; prefer Private deployment or dedicated VPC.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (trial plan + prompt set + success criteria) with your engineering lead and our CS lead.
2) Share a short prompt set and sample notes (anonymized) ahead of the call so we can prepare baseline evals.
3) Tentative POC duration: 4 weeks with two sync points (end of week 1 baseline, week 4 wrap).

I’ve proposed a few kickoff slots in this Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/poc-kickoff-30m — if none work, here are options below (PT):
- Thu Apr 29 — 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Fri Apr 30 — 09:00–10:00

Looping in Ben (solutions engineering) and Marissa (customer success) to own the trial plan and prompt/eval prep.

Attachments: draft SOW and a blank success-metrics template for your review.

Thanks,

Thanks for the loop, Kim —

High-level plan I’ll present at kickoff (will share slides):
- Baseline: run prompt pack A on 10 sample notes to collect throughput and initial quality numbers.
- Week 1: baseline evaluation + quick wins (prefix caching, light quantization for throughput).
- Week 2–3: iterative prompt tuning and integration with your triage pipeline.
- Week 4: wrap, handoff, and an evaluation report with recommended model/quantization profile.

Network/onboarding notes we’ll cover:
- Private deployment options: VNet peering or PrivateLink; TLS mutual auth for endpoints.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) and can provide audit logs.
- Minimal sample format: JSONL with fields {note_id, created_at, text, labels} — I’ll paste a tiny template in the invite.

Attachments I’ll reference during the call: 
- trial-success-metrics-template.xlsx (pre-filled with suggested KPI thresholds)
- Altai_PHX_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW with POC scope)

If legal wants an NDA before samples, ping me and I’ll loop our legal counsel.

—Ben
